 Jeremiah Fears leads offense in Friday's loss to Timberwolves 
 by Chris Schommer | Pelicans Correspondent | Sat, Nov 7th 2026, 4:15pm EST 
 Jeremiah Fears led the Pelicans offense Friday night, scoring 24 points (9-16 FG, 0-1 3PT, 6-7 FT) while also dishing out five assists, recording two steals, and grabbing five rebounds in a 115-109 loss to the Timberwolves. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Fears continues a steady stretch on both ends of the floor, dishing out two or more assists, grabbing four or more rebounds, and scoring 12 or more points in each of his last five contests. The guard continues to capitalize on more sizeable role out of the New Orleans backcourt early on, averaging 14.8 points, 4.6 rebounds, and 4.6 assists per game to go along with a usage rate of 24.6% so far this season.
